task.instruction: Analyze the bug. Describe root cause and possible approaches.
Implement fix approach A (minimal targeted fix). Create PR.
Implement fix approach B (broader refactor addressing root cause). Create PR.
Run full test suite on solution A.
Run full test suite on solution B.
Compare both solutions. Score: correctness(40%), coverage(30%), quality(20%), minimalism(10%). Pick winner.
Merge winning solution. Close losing PR with explanation.
